user.title: Hoval CAN
user.description: Connect to your Hoval WLAN gateway (CAN-BUS TCP stream on port 3113).

data_description.host: IP address of the Hoval WLAN gateway on your local network.
data_description.port: TCP port of the CAN-BUS stream (default: 3113).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable on port 3113.

data_description.cop: Used to calculate heat pump electrical power and energy from thermal output. Typical range 2.0–8.0. Default: 6.3. Changing this value reloads the integration; accumulated energy totals are preserved.
